scripts.dev: concurrently "cd renderer && npx next dev" "py -3.11 -m uvicorn backend.app.main:app --reload"
scripts.dev-electron: concurrently "cd renderer && npx next dev" "tsx main/main.ts"
scripts.build: npm run build-renderer && npm run build-electron
scripts.build-electron: tsx -c tsc --outDir dist --target es2018 main/main.ts && npx electron-builder
